intro:
A huge heap of scrap metal blocks the way…
Did it just move?
title: Treasure in the Scrap
description: Rusty scrap metal is piled up like a mountain, blocking the path. Something useful might be buried in it. But didn’t the heap just twitch…?

and knock on it here and there…

Suddenly, the scrap heap stands up!
It wasn’t scrap, it was a Pokémon!

looking for anything useful…
